messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH - rwd-infer-prod-1 - spike in 5xxs and KV cache miss rate > 40% for last 3m. Affects endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Link: https://ops.redwood/internal/incidents/INC-12345 :rotating_light:
alex_oncall: on it. I’m connecting to the node pool now. tagging @matt_sre for runtime support.
matt_sre: joining. grabbing logs, can someone repro traffic pattern? any deploys in last hour?
priya_se: no prod deploys from infra but we pushed quantized model v3.2 to canary ~20m ago, small % of traffic.
alex_oncall: ok — initial hypothesis: quantized path + larger batching exposed KV cache pressure.
santi_research: adding detail — quant v3.2 changes KV layout; observed higher eviction rates in staging when sequence length > 1024. Could be interacting with continuous batching.
elaine_prod: customer-impact: several high-traffic accounts reported 5xxs and increased latency. CS triage ticket created: CS-9876. Jim is on support bridge.
jim_support: on bridge, customers see failed responses ~10-15% for some routes. Providing logs to customers as we investigate.
matt_sre: quick mitigation options: 1) reduce max batch size to 8 (from 32) 2) force fallback to non-quant model variant for canary 3) evict/rewarm KV caches for affected nodes. I recommend 1+2 asap.
alex_oncall: agreed. rolling a config change: set batch.max_tokens=2048, batch.max_items=8 on pool rwd-prod-1. doing canary rollout to 2 nodes now.
incident-bot: Deploy started: config-change-5150001245 by alex_oncall - setting batch.max_items=8 to rwd-prod-1 (canary 2/12 nodes).
matt_sre: canary nodes show 60% drop in 5xx after batch change. KV miss rate down from 42% -> 18% on canary. Good signal.
priya_se: enabling fallback policy to non-quant model for canary traffic now. command: `redwood route set-fallback --pool rwd-prod-1 --variant non-quant-v3`
incident-bot: Route update completed by priya_se 5150001310.
elaine_prod: CS update: impacted customers seeing recovery, errors down to ~2-3% on canary. continuing to monitor.
santi_research: note: rewarm will be costly but necessary if we want to reintroduce quant. recommend background prefill of KV for traffic patterns.
matt_sre: opened remediation ticket REM-54321 to track: KV rewarm job, batching tuning, quant regression CI test. Adding details and owners.
alex_oncall: action items (short):
- A1: keep batch.max_items=8 globally until root cause validated (owner: matt_sre)
- A2: run nightly KV rewarm job on rwd-prod-1 for top-10 models (owner: priya_se)
- A3: add regression test for quantized KV eviction at high sequence lengths (owner: santi_research)
- A4: follow-up postmortem with CS + eng + infra tomorrow 09:30 UTC (owner: alex_oncall)
- A5: communicate RCA timeline to affected customers via CS (owner: elaine_prod)
matt_sre: started REM-54321 and linked logs + canary metrics. ETA to complete triage 48h.
priya_se: scheduling KV rewarm job as low-priority batch: `jobs create --type=kv-rewarm --models=top10 --window=0300-0400`
jim_support: confirming CS-9876 updated with mitigation steps and next update scheduled +2h.
alex_oncall: booking postmortem: created calendar invite PMT-5150001400, attendees: eng-runtime, eng-oncall, eng-ml, product, CS. Please accept.
santi_research: initial root cause theory: quant v3.2 changed shard alignment -> uneven KV density -> higher eviction under large batch pressure. Need deeper kernel-level profiling.
matt_sre: note for postmortem: capture kernel traces, allocator stats, and batching telemetry for the incident window.
elaine_prod: customers notified. no escalations yet.
alex_oncall: current status: mitigation applied to prod (fallback + reduced batching), errors reduced to baseline on all canaries. keeping this thread open for remediation tracking and postmortem prep.
incident-bot: Incident INC-12345 changed status: mitigated at 5150001505 by alex_oncall.
alex_oncall: final quick checklist before closing incident:
- verify REM-54321 has owners and due dates
- postmortem draft by end of day tomorrow
- update runbooks with emergency rollback steps for quant deployments
- schedule follow-up to validate reintroduction of quant with canary ramp plan
I'll follow up in REM-54321 with links. thanks all :thumbsup:
